example.code:
import tempfile
from scirel.kinetic.fluidbw import derive_fluidbw_case,solve_fluidbw_bonk,render_fluidbw_materials
s=derive_fluidbw_case('bonk',2);r=solve_fluidbw_bonk(2,[.63*s['wn'].item()])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    files=render_fluidbw_materials(r,'bonk',folder)
example.description: Requires Linux amd64 and GNU Octave 7.3.0; this example exercises the native fluidBW boundary and is reported as NOT_RUN on macOS.
example.expected: NOT_RUN on this macOS host: the call reaches the fluidBW runtime guard and raises RuntimeError("fluidBW requires the pinned Linux amd64 runtime").

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result. Material rendering may have written files before a backend error; those files are not a successful returned result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises RuntimeError before numerical evaluation unless the pinned Linux amd64 and GNU Octave 7.3.0 runtime is available; native errors propagate and no fallback is selected.

assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.definition: Unit-labelled source-derived graphics; BONKcase1/2/3 PNG; EMjplt1/2 PNG and case-dependent ICW/ECW MAT.
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation

inputs.constraints: Family must correspond to the graph result.
inputs.description: Complete returned BONK/EM graph state with material metadata.
inputs.name: result

inputs.constraints: Caller-owned directory; produced filenames returned including overwrites.
inputs.name: output_directory

outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.

outputs.name: result
outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described

summary: Render every retained BONK/EM plot branch and EM MAT outputs from complete graph results, with corrected labels and actual artifact reporting.
